caption: The drawing depicts a single large bronze or brass bell, colored in muted tones of brown, green, and gold, with subtle shading to indicate its metallic surface and three-dimensional shape. The bell has a broad, flared bottom edge with several thin, horizontal grooves encircling it near the rim. There is a decorative band near the top of the bell that contains raised lettering, with part of the inscription reading "ELIZABETHTOWN." The top of the bell features a prominent crown with a mounting structure, which is rectangular and has a looped section for hanging or securing the bell. Below the bell’s main body, the clapper is partially visible. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of an off-white or light beige color with no additional elements. The signature "ESchwabe" appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Courthouse Bell
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
